This is true, but very largely they are overlapping. But that's really not the point. The point is, where does beauty come from in the first place? This is a question Darwin asked repeatedly. Yes, given beauty, it can be used for mate selection. But where is beauty from? Why is something considered beautiful? What is it? And I think it's a very astute question. And I think these things preexist us. I think they are part of the way the cosmos is, even before we were around. There were very beautiful creatures.
